bio: Backend Developer with experience building scalable APIs using Python (FastAPI) and Node.js (Express.js), plus distributed streaming systems. Built a secure payment gateway application with RSA encryption and MongoDB. Improved system performance (p95 latency reduced 25%, response time reduced 30%) using Redis caching, PostgreSQL optimization, and CI/CD automation. Experienced with Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, Docker, Kubernetes, and full-stack observability tooling.
